notes: Rate 5.3% (in effect since Jan 1, 2025; confirmed by the 2025 Form 40/43 instructions EIN00046). No 2026 rate-cut bill became law in the 2026 session (the 2026 enacted list shows only HB 559 IRC conformity and unrelated income-tax bills), so 5.3% applies for 2026.

Zero-rate amount: the first $4,811 (single/MFS) or $9,622 (married filing jointly, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse) of Idaho taxable income is taxed at 0% for 2025 (Form 40 tax computation worksheet). Idaho indexes these amounts yearly; the 2026 values had not been published, so 2025 values are used.
Head of household uses the $9,622 married amount: confirmed by the 2025 Form 40 instructions tax computation worksheet.

Idaho conforms to the IRC as of January 1, 2026 (2025 Form 40 instructions) and uses the federal standard deduction (2025: $15,750 / $31,500 / $23,625, matching the federal amounts). The 2026 federal amounts ($16,100 / $32,200 / $24,150) are used on that basis; Idaho's 2026 instructions are not yet published.

Not modeled: Food Tax Credit ($155 per person in 2025, refundable; about $155 single / $310 joint less tax), $10 permanent building fund tax, Idaho additions/subtractions to federal AGI (e.g. bonus depreciation decoupling), itemized deductions and other credits.

seDeduction.note: Inherited: Idaho starts from federal AGI, which reflects the deductible half of SE tax.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are inherited through federal AGI.

qbi.note: Idaho taxable income is federal AGI less the standard/itemized deduction; the federal QBI deduction is not part of the Idaho computation.

localIncomeTax.note: No Idaho city or county levies an income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Idaho doesn't require estimated tax payments from individuals (2025 Form 40 instructions, 'When to File and Pay'); Idaho Code 63-3036A imposes estimated-tax requirements only on corporations. You can prepay at any time online or with Form 51. Tax not paid by the April 15 return due date accrues interest (6% for 2026).
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No individual underpayment-of-estimated-tax penalty. To get the automatic 6-month filing extension, by April 15 pay at least 100% of the prior year's Idaho tax or 80% of the current year's tax (Form 51 worksheet); otherwise an extension penalty can apply.
estimatedTax.form: Form 51 (Estimated Payment of Idaho Individual Income Tax), optional

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 Certificate of Organization (Idaho Code 30-21-214(b)(16)) filed online at SOSBiz; $120 on paper including the $20 manual processing fee.
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $0: Idaho charges no fee for the annual report (Idaho Code 30-21-214(b)(7)); file online at SOSBiz by the end of the LLC's anniversary month each year (Idaho Code 30-21-213(c)). Paper filings add a $20 manual processing fee.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for a sole proprietor or a disregarded single-member LLC.
